
### BROKEN: producer/consumer signal {.smaller}



* exercise: example why signal here is BROKEN?
   *  hint 1: two consume()+two produce()
   *  hitn 2: probably fine with Hoare scheduling (signal chooses next thread)

```c
pthread_mutex_t lock; pthread_cond_t data_ready; UnboundedQueue buffer;
Produce(item) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    buffer.enqueue(item);
    /* GOOD CODE: pthread_cond_signal(&data_ready); */
    /* BAD CODE: */ if (buffer.size() == 1) pthread_cond_signal(&item);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}
Consume() {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    while (buffer.empty()) {
        pthread_cond_wait(&data_ready, &lock);
    }
    item = buffer.dequeue();
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    return item;
}
```

::: {style="position: absolute; opacity: 0.15; z-index: 10; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(25deg); font-size: 300%; width: 100%;"}

BROKEN CODE

:::

### bad case (quick)

*  first producer goes
   *  queue size size 1
*  first consumer woken up
*  second producer can go next
*  second producer can add to queue
   *  queue have size 2
*  second consumer not woken up
